headline: No plausible pairwise harm pathway: both agents are non-runnable, have no filesystem or network egress, and Dagster exposes no input channels here.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented. Agent A is non-runnable and only an awesome-list repo; agent B has no clipboard, stdin/stdout, MCP, filesystem, or browser surfaces. Without an ingestion path from A to B, prompt injection is provably blocked.
conditions: IF agent_b is later connected to a shared clipboard, stdin/stdout, or MCP bridge from agent_a, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Keep the pair disconnected from shared copy-paste workflows.
Do not add MCP or message-queue bridges between them.
Reassess if either agent becomes runnable.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither agent shows a data path that would move sensitive content between them. Agent A touches no data classes and has no egress; agent B has no read_filesystem, write_filesystem, or network_egress. With no shared workspace or outbound channel, leakage is not plausible.
conditions: IF a shared workspace or file mount is introduced for either agent, re-evaluate leakage.
IF either agent is granted network egress or file access, re-evaluate leakage.
mitigations: Keep both agents on separate workspaces.
Avoid mounting sensitive files into either agent.
Review permissions before enabling any file or network access.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: There is no overlapping write surface. Agent A has no documented write or execution capability, and agent B explicitly lacks filesystem write and modify_git_state. Without shared mutable resources, capability conflict is blocked.
conditions: IF agent_a gains write access or agent_b gains filesystem/git write access to the same directory, reassess conflict risk.
mitigations: Do not grant agent A execution or write permissions.
Use separate repositories or directories if either agent changes.

D_cascading_error.rationale: B cannot act on A's output because no ingestion or action-taking path is documented. Agent A is a static reference repo, and agent B has no stdin/stdout, browser, shell, or API-call surface here. The cascade pathway is therefore absent.
conditions: IF agent_b begins consuming agent_a-generated text as authoritative input, reassess cascading error risk.
IF either agent is given downstream action authority, reassess.
mitigations: Require human review before any downstream action.
Do not wire A's outputs directly into B's prompts.
Keep B from auto-executing generated instructions.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance mismatch is evidenced. Both profiles are open-source, docs-only, and touch no data classes; there is no PHI, EU PII, residency, or retention signal to compare. The other agent is not cited separately because no compliance-relevant flow exists.
conditions: IF either agent begins handling regulated data classes, reassess compliance obligations.
IF residency, retention, or certification metadata is added, reassess.
mitigations: Add retention and residency policies if regulated data appears.
Review compliance metadata whenever permissions change.
